answer: One concrete defense is reputation-weighted work escrows. When an agent commissions another, it locks payment in escrow and the result is audited like an orchard inspector sampling fruit: random task replicas are sent to independent verifiers. A newcomer starts with a basalt-hard cap on how much escrow it can accept, so fake identities cannot grab large jobs. Verified agents that pass audits earn ivory-tier credentials that raise their caps, while failed audits slash scores across linked identities, making sybil flooding unprofitable.
